faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Climate Change Mission, Cuddalore (DCCM Cuddalore) for filling up temporary vacancies under state government climate initiatives.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DCCM Cuddalore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant post under this recruitment notification released in September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DCCM Cuddalore Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email or directly at the Cuddalore District Collectorate is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences, Environmental Science, Ecology, Forestry, Wild Life Science, Public Policy, or an M.A. in English with basic typing skills.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Technical Assistant position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 22,000/- per month on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as specified in the official notification guidelines issued by DCCM Cuddalore.

faq.question: Q7. How should I submit my application for this job?
faq.answer: You can send your updated Resume and documents via email to [email protected] or submit them directly at the Cuddalore District Collectorate office.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for DCCM Cuddalore recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to be paid by candidates applying for the Technical Assistant position as per the notification details.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this technical role?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an initial application eligibility screening, followed by an interview and a typing test for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section of this article and clicking on the provided direct link.
